summary: Iteration 12 - Frontend-only validation of 4 new/replaced pages (LeasingPage, ChauffeurServicePage, UsedCarsPage, TrucklinePage) plus brand audit (EGMG → Eurogulf Mobility Group, #EE5A01 CTAs, Roboto/Calibri body) at https://egmg-premium.preview.emergentagent.com. All 4 target pages render with centered heroes, orange CTAs (verified computed bg = rgb(238,90,1) = #EE5A01), correct H1 text, full content sections, and are responsive on 390px mobile (no horizontal overflow). LeasingPage: ROI calculator slider+selects interactive, all 12 UAE partners present, 4 tier cards (12/24/36/48 months) with 'Most Popular' badge on 24 months. ChauffeurServicePage: trust points (Fully Insured / Vetted Drivers / Fixed Fares), 4 service cards (Airport Transfer / One-Way / Half-Day / Full-Day), 3-step How-It-Works, 4 fleet cards (Lexus, Audi, Mercedes, GMC), Book Now → /book-chauffeur. UsedCarsPage: live countdown (04D:03H:03M:36S) to Mon 12:00 GST, How the Auction Works section, advantages (Single-Owner, Inspection, Service History, Clean RTA), 6 vehicle cards with grade badges. TrucklinePage: stats bar (12,000+ vehicles, 5 workshops, <90 min SLA, ISO 9001), four services, sectors served, 10 egmg.ae client logos. Body font correctly resolves to 'Roboto, Calibri, sans-serif'. HomePage: 0 standalone 'EGMG', 7× 'Eurogulf Mobility Group' visible. HOWEVER, 3 OTHER PAGES still contain standalone 'EGMG' in user-facing copy (AboutPage timeline 2024, LeadershipPage 3 bios, BusinessesPage Used Cars description) — these were not in the 4-page scope but the brand requirement says 'all user-facing text'.
